questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Dragons or Titans?
Who took South Africa Women's first-ever Test five-wicket haul, against England at Durban on 31 December 1960, just weeks after the team's very first Test?
questions.explanation: McNaughton took 6 wickets against England in South Africa's second-ever Test, weeks after their debut.

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 5 wickets in a match double more times, Dané van Niekerk or Robyn Searle?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk: 2 times. Robyn Searle: 1 times.

questions.question: Susan Benade set a database record (List A) with a value of 76. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Matches as Captain', held by Susan Benade.

questions.question: At which ground did Titans record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 421, against Limpopo Lillies on 2011/02/27.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' in the 14/15 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Robyn Appels holds it, with a total of 22.
